description: Vietnam Airlines Lotusmiles award miles, tier miles and tier segments for Vietnam Airlines flights (rates from 26 August 2026). Award miles = distance x fare family rate (fam: Business Flex 200%, Business Classic 150, Premium Economy Flex 130, Premium Economy Classic 120, Economy Flex 110, Economy Classic 80 within Vietnam and 65 abroad, Economy Lite 60 and 25, Economy Super Lite 10), rounded down per flight; Vietnam Airlines prints the rates as decimals (2.00), read as multipliers of the miles flown. Tier miles are the award miles without the tier bonus (Economy Super Lite earns none); tier segments per flight by fare family and distance band. The Titanium 30%, Gold 50% and Platinum or Million Miler 100% bonus adds award miles only. Progress toward Titanium (15,000 tier miles or 20 segments), Gold (30,000 or 30) and Platinum (50,000 or 50) in 12 months; tm and ts are the totals so far. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports (both VN = domestic rate). Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Vietnam Airlines's own: delta = Delta SkyMiles (creditStatus one of: SkyMiles Member, Silver Medallion, Gold Medallion, Platinum Medallion, Diamond Medallion); flying-club = Flying Club (creditStatus one of: Red, Silver, Gold); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

fam.description: Fare family. BF = Business Flex (Business, J, C); BC = Business Classic (Business, D, I); PF = Premium Economy Flex (Premium Economy, W); PC = Premium Economy Classic (Premium Economy, Z, U); EF = Economy Flex (Economy, Y, M, B); EC = Economy Classic (Economy, S, H, K, L); EL = Economy Lite (Economy, Q, N, R, T, E); ES = Economy Super Lite (Economy, A, P, G). The fare family on your ticket, or its booking class in brackets. Booking class Q on routes between Vietnam and Europe, Australia, the United States or China counts as Economy Classic.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your Lotusmiles tier. NO = Registration; SI = Silver; TI = Titanium (+30%); GO = Gold (+50%); PL = Platinum (+100%); MM = Million Miler (+100%). The tier bonus is paid on award miles for Vietnam Airlines flights; it does not count toward tier miles or segments.

tm.description: Tier miles you have in your 12-month period (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next tier.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.

ts.description: Tier segments you have in your 12-month period (optional). Some fares count half a segment.
